content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial is for missing required prior authorization; the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Eligibility, billing order, and diagnosis pairing are valid, so correcting or resubmitting the claim would not resolve the denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table and can progress the claim without improperly transferring the authorization denial to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
